summaries.name: Outer Space Expedition
summaries.summary: Outer Space Expedition is a space-themed party idea suggested on 2023/03/17 for Olivia's 6th birthday, featuring planetary decorations and activities including a Space Mission Scavenger Hunt, Alien Slime Making (glue, water, and food coloring), Space Suit Dress-up with photos, and a Moon Walk Challenge obstacle course with asteroid hurdles and black hole tunnels. Party favors suggested for this theme include glow sticks, star-shaped cookies, and space-themed stickers and coloring books.
